scope: B1 M4 balanced-price guided columns in original root loop; no default changes, no schedule changes

correctness: Balance only discovery prices. Recompute raw directed route cost and reduced cost with CURRENT ORIGINAL master prices, deduplicate then add; never use balanced pricing bound/status for original certificate or LP closure. root_matrix.total_scope: Input loading, audit, projection, root setup/build/discovery/certification charged; process imports separately recorded

gate: All audits pass; candidate improves effective E2 bound by >1e-5 in >=8/12 pairs including both sources, all three seeds and both budgets, with no >1e-5 regressions; OR same positive root LP optimum, complete on all pairs and lower total wall/work on each source/budget aggregate. Zero E2 and better negative raw corrections alone fail. No favorable reruns or selected subsets.
complete_integer_gate: Only if root gate passes: register a separate frozen full solver control before executing; root alone never permits production-default adoption. Complete original integer same-input/start/total-budget multi-source/seed comparison and independent audit/regression required.
rejection: Keep closed prototype if root gate fails; do not spend a full MILP matrix on a zero-bound mechanism. Preserve every failure and negative result; no adaptive budget candidate bundled here.
budgets: Serial subprocess hard protection budget+30 seconds; retain stdout/stderr, inputs, starts, source/parameters SHA256 and results. No automatic retry after solver failure.
stopped_automation: m1-m4 remains paused; this new human-authorized experiment is synchronous and has its own checkpoint
load: Read ALNS/M5 checkpoint status and machine load before/after every job, inspect current model6 activity where available; do not claim CPU-exclusive execution.
